question: Churahi, Mandeali and Keonthali are dialects spoken in the state of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Himachal Pradesh.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Churahi, Mandeali, and Keonthali** are dialects spoken in the state of **Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• About Himachal Pradesh:
 
 
• **Capital**: Shimla (Summers) & Dharamsala (Winters).
 
• **Formed in**: -Himachal Pradesh was conferred statehood on 25th January 1971.
 
• **Languages**: - Hindi (Official Language) & English (Additional official language) - Pahari, Dogri, Mandeali, Kangri, and Kinnauri.
 
• **Regional festivals**: Halda, Lohri, Baisakhi, Himachal Winter carnival, Kullu Dussehra, Phulaich, Lossar, Sairi, Faguli.
 
• **Geographical indications**: Kullu shawl, Kangra Tea, Chamba Rumal, Kinnauri Shawl.
 
• **World heritage sites**: Great Himalayan National Park, Kalka-Shimla Railway under Mountain Railways of India.
